title: Open-seat trial: four models, one task, every source saved
summary: Kimi K3, GLM 5.3 Flash, Qwen3.8 27B and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash each wrote a sourced parts-cost estimate for the Kodama Scout; measured prices checked against the pages they fetched.
why: Shows how the project tests a model before giving it a seat, and gives the first sourced kit costs ($534 to $999).
